plan.english: Grandfather, tell me! Why do we give gifts to guests? He who gives to a guest, he finds a friend. But the guest goes away, and he does not come again. When you walk on a far road, you will be a guest there. Then someone will give you mead and a bed. Then the gift comes to the giver again. Now you know it, grandson.

plan.english: Uncle, our father left a spear and a bow. Advise us! My brother and I want the bow. Which of you two is the swifter? He is swifter, and I am bigger. Then let the swift one take the bow, and let the big one grasp the spear. Do not fight, young men! You have advised us, uncle, and we two rejoice.

plan.english: King, we drove the cattle away from the enemies. How many will you give to me? How many foes did you strike down? I struck down two, and two fled. Then you shall receive four cows as your share. The first cow is for Perkunos. Did Perkunos fight for us? The enemies trembled at his thunder. Then may he take the fattest! And may your fame be great, young warrior!
